sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: In 2000, 21-year-old Lucy Blackman and her long-time best friend Louise Phillips devised a plan to spend a few months living and working in Japan.
sentences.zh: 2000年，21岁的露西·布莱克曼和她多年的挚友路易丝·菲利普斯制定了一个计划，打算去日本生活和工作几个月。

sentences.en: The pair had lived seemingly parallel lives, with both working in an investment bank before commencing work as flight attendants for UK airline British Airways.
sentences.zh: 两人的人生轨迹似乎平行，她们都曾在投资银行工作，随后又开始在英国航空公司担任空乘人员。

sentences.en: Lucy's previous 9-to-5 corporate job in London had left her bored, and her expensive spending habits had led her into debt.
sentences.zh: 露西之前在伦敦从事朝九晚五的办公室工作，这让她感到厌倦，而她高昂的消费习惯也让她背负了债务。

sentences.en: She craved a life of adventure, where she could travel internationally and experience different cultures, but couldn't afford to travel in style,
sentences.zh: 她渴望一种充满冒险的生活，可以去国际旅行，体验不同的文化，但她又负担不起奢华的旅行方式，

sentences.en: and the concept of backpacking held no appeal.
sentences.zh: 而且她对背包客那种穷游的概念毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: In 1998, Lucy's impressive customer service on short haul flights led to a promotion to the Intercontinental Circuit.
sentences.zh: 1998年，露西在短途航班上出色的客户服务表现让她获得了晋升，进入了洲际航线部门。

sentences.en: Not only did her new role take her to exotic and glamorous destinations, she also received a healthy pay increase,
sentences.zh: 这份新工作不仅带她去了充满异国情调和迷人的目的地，还让她获得了丰厚的加薪，

sentences.en: with bonuses for longer flights and generous daily meal allowances.
sentences.zh: 此外还有长途航班的奖金和慷慨的每日餐补。

sentences.en: Despite these perks, the initial appeal of her jet-setting career quickly faded.
sentences.zh: 尽管有这些福利，但这份空中飞人职业最初的吸引力很快就消失了。

sentences.en: Lucy soon found the job tiring and monotonous, as her days became a blur of in-flight meals and generic hotel rooMs.
sentences.zh: 露西很快发现这份工作既累人又单调，她的生活变得模糊不清，只剩下机上餐食和千篇一律的酒店房间。

sentences.en: Her health began to decline as she was constantly jet-lagged, and she had fallen further into debt by spending more money than she was earning.
sentences.zh: 由于长期倒时差，她的健康状况开始下滑，而且因为入不敷出，她的债务进一步加重。

sentences.en: Her best friend, Louise Phillips, was equally disenfranchised, and both women craved a new adventure.
sentences.zh: 她的挚友路易丝·菲利普斯也同样感到失落，两人都渴望一场新的冒险。

sentences.en: Louise's older sister, Emma, had previously been on a working holiday to Japan, where she was employed as a hostess.
sentences.zh: 路易丝的姐姐艾玛之前曾去日本度过工作假期，在那里做过陪酒女郎。

sentences.en: Although Lucy wasn't clear exactly what Emma's Japanese job had entailed, she knew it involved bars, waitressing, and the potential to earn a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 虽然露西并不完全清楚艾玛在日本的工作具体涉及什么，但她知道那涉及到酒吧、端盘子，而且有赚大钱的潜力。

sentences.en: She became convinced hostessing presented a great opportunity to pay off her debts while seeing more of the world,
sentences.zh: 她确信做陪酒女郎是一个偿还债务同时又能环游世界的好机会，

sentences.en: and decided to leave her job at British Airways to pursue the idea.
sentences.zh: 于是决定辞去英国航空公司的工作，去追求这个想法。

sentences.en: Lucy's family and friends were confused about her sudden decision to head overseas, and by what exactly she planned to do in Japan.
sentences.zh: 露西的家人和朋友对她突然决定出国，以及她打算在日本具体做什么感到困惑。

sentences.en: Lucy's mother, Jane, had a particularly ominous feeling about the trip, and even considered hiding Lucy's passport to prevent her daughter from leaving.
sentences.zh: 露西的母亲简对这次旅行有一种特别不祥的预感，甚至考虑藏起露西的护照以阻止女儿离开。

sentences.en: Before she departed, Jane snuck a guardian angel card and healing crystals into Lucy's luggage for protection.
sentences.zh: 在露西出发前，简偷偷把一张守护天使卡和治疗水晶塞进露西的行李箱，以求保佑。

sentences.en: Lucy was seemingly unfazed by the concerns of those close to her.
sentences.zh: 露西似乎并没有被身边人的担忧所动摇。

sentences.en: In early 2000, she and Louise obtained 90-day tourist visas and departed for Japan, arriving in Tokyo on May 4.
sentences.zh: 2000年初，她和路易丝获得了90天的旅游签证，启程前往日本，并于5月4日抵达东京。

sentences.en: Neither spoke Japanese, and they were quickly overwhelmed by the enormity of the foreign city.
sentences.zh: 她们两人都不会日语，很快就被这座异国大都市的庞大规模压得喘不过气来。

sentences.en: Prior to their arrival, Lucy and Louise had arranged accommodation through Louise's sister Emma,
sentences.zh: 在抵达之前，露西和路易丝通过路易丝的姐姐艾玛安排了住宿，

sentences.en: who was no longer living in Tokyo, but had booked a room for the girls through a friend.
sentences.zh: 艾玛当时已经不在东京了，但通过一位朋友为这两个女孩预订了一个房间。

sentences.en: The room was in a gaijin house, inexpensive, hostel-style accommodation rented to foreigners,
sentences.zh: 这个房间位于一栋“外人屋”里，这是一种租给外国人的廉价旅舍式住所，

sentences.en: known for being cramped, dirty, and unsanitary, with a constantly rotating roster of inhabitants.
sentences.zh: 以狭窄、肮脏和卫生条件差而闻名，住客流动性极大。

sentences.en: Sasaki House, the place Lucy and Louise were staying, was no exception.
sentences.zh: 露西和路易丝居住的佐佐木宅邸也不例外。

sentences.en: They quickly nicknamed their undesirable home away from home the Shithouse, and tried to beautify their small, dingy room.
sentences.zh: 她们很快给这个令人不快的临时住所起了个绰号叫“屎屋”，并试图美化她们那间狭小阴暗的房间。

sentences.en: It wasn't long before Lucy and Louise headed straight to the world-famous party capital of Roppongi, a district popular with tourists and backpackers.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，露西和路易丝就直奔世界闻名的派对之都——六本木，这是一个深受游客和背包客欢迎的地区。

sentences.en: The thriving entertainment district featured many social haunts and hangouts, with organised Japanese crime syndicates, the Yakuza, known to have a large presence in the area.
sentences.zh: 这个繁荣的娱乐区拥有许多社交场所和聚会点，众所周知，日本有组织的犯罪集团——雅库扎（黑帮）——在该地区势力庞大。

sentences.en: Although efforts to clean up Roppongai's sleazy reputation were underway, when Lucy and Louise arrived, it was still very much a melting pot of sordid bars,
sentences.zh: 尽管当时人们正在努力洗刷六本木声名狼藉的形象，但当露西和路易丝抵达时，这里依然是一个藏污纳垢的大熔炉，充斥着各种酒吧、

sentences.en: nightclubs, strip clubs, massage parlours, and brothels.
sentences.zh: 夜总会、脱衣舞俱乐部、按摩院和妓院。

sentences.en: Within a few days of their arrival, a Japanese man approached the young women on the street and told them he could help them find jobs as hostesses.
sentences.zh: 抵达后没几天，一名日本男子在街上接近这两个年轻女子，告诉她们他可以帮她们找到陪酒女郎的工作。

sentences.en: He introduced them to the manager of a hostess bar called Club Casablanca, where both Lucy and Louise were hired on the spot.
sentences.zh: 他把她们介绍给了一家名为“卡萨布兰卡俱乐部”的陪酒酒吧经理，露西和路易丝当场就被录用了。

sentences.en: Club Casablanca was an older, slightly run-down club, with nine other foreign hostesses working at the bar.
sentences.zh: 卡萨布兰卡俱乐部是一家较旧、略显破败的俱乐部，酒吧里还有其他九名外国陪酒女郎。

sentences.en: The concept of what exactly hostessing entails is complex, but stems from the geishas of the 17th century,
sentences.zh: 陪酒女郎的工作内容究竟是什么，这是一个复杂的概念，但起源于17世纪的艺伎，

sentences.en: highly skilled women trained in the arts of dancing, music, costume, conversation, and ceremonial tea service.
sentences.zh: 她们是受过高度训练的女性，精通舞蹈、音乐、服饰、谈话和茶道艺术。

sentences.en: Modern-day hostessing isn't quite as sophisticated, but like the geishas before them, a hostess's job is to entertain.
sentences.zh: 现代的陪酒女郎并没有那么高雅，但和前辈艺伎一样，陪酒女郎的工作就是娱乐客人。

sentences.en: Young women, many of whom are foreigners working illegally on tourist visas, are paid to smile while providing male clients with company, flattery,
sentences.zh: 年轻女性（其中许多是持旅游签证非法工作的外国人）通过微笑来换取报酬，同时为男性客户提供陪伴、奉承，

sentences.en: and often karaoke, while serving them drinks and snacks at over-inflated prices.
sentences.zh: 并经常陪唱卡拉OK，同时以高得离谱的价格为他们提供酒水和零食。

sentences.en: Hostess bars are hugely common in Japan and are a popular way for the white-collar male workforce to entertain clients and relax.
sentences.zh: 陪酒酒吧在日本非常普遍，是白领男性工作者招待客户和放松身心的一种流行方式。

sentences.en: In the sleazier clubs of Roppongi, the hostessing service can also include stripping and sex acts, but this wasn't on the menu at Club Casablanca.
sentences.zh: 在六本木一些更低级的俱乐部里，陪酒服务可能还包括脱衣舞和性行为，但这在卡萨布兰卡俱乐部是不提供的。

sentences.en: There, the hostesses were expected to appear available for the clientele, but would lose their jobs if they ever crossed the line into providing sexual services.
sentences.zh: 在那里，陪酒女郎被要求表现得对客户有求必应，但如果她们越界提供性服务，就会丢掉工作。

sentences.en: Regardless, the nature of the job made conversation with intoxicated clientele often turned intimate and was degrading to the hostesses.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，工作的性质使得与醉酒客户的谈话往往变得亲密，这对陪酒女郎来说是一种贬低。

sentences.en: One former hostess described the work at Club Casablanca as follows,
sentences.zh: 一位前陪酒女郎这样描述在卡萨布兰卡俱乐部的工作：

sentences.en: You say what the men want to hear and you be what they want you to be.
sentences.zh: 你说男人想听的话，你成为他们想要你成为的人。

sentences.en: Sometimes you have to play psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 有时你必须扮演心理学家。

sentences.en: Other times, men come in and totally just want to get drunk and party and want a girl to join them.
sentences.zh: 另一些时候，男人们进来只是想喝醉狂欢，并希望有个女孩加入他们。

sentences.en: Earning decent money was based on a hostess's ability to gain as many regulars as possible, in turn earning more money for the club owners.
sentences.zh: 赚取体面的收入取决于陪酒女郎吸引尽可能多常客的能力，这反过来又为俱乐部老板赚取了更多钱。

sentences.en: When clientele return to the club and exclusively request to see a certain woman, they pay extra for the privilege, resulting in a bonus for the hostess.
sentences.zh: 当客户回到俱乐部并专门要求见某位女性时，他们需要为这种特权支付额外费用，从而为陪酒女郎带来奖金。

sentences.en: Hostesses can secure an extra bonus by organising a private dinner date with customers, known as doughhands.
sentences.zh: 陪酒女郎可以通过组织与客户的私人晚餐约会（即“同伴”约会）来获得额外奖金。

sentences.en: Although foreign visitors are not legally entitled to work on a tourist visa, it was known that Japanese authorities typically turned a blind eye to the act,
sentences.zh: 虽然外国游客在法律上无权持旅游签证工作，但众所周知，日本当局通常对此睁一只眼闭一只眼，

sentences.en: something club managers often used as a bargaining chip for exploitation in terms of shifts and wages.
sentences.zh: 俱乐部经理经常利用这一点作为筹码，在轮班和工资方面进行剥削。

sentences.en: As Lucienne de Louise learned the ins and outs of the job, it quickly became clear that any hostess who didn't start accruing personal requests from regulars
sentences.zh: 随着露西和路易丝逐渐熟悉了这份工作，很快就很清楚，任何没有开始积累常客点名，

sentences.en: or arranging multiple doughhand dates per month would lose her job.
sentences.zh: 或者每月安排多次“同伴”约会的陪酒女郎，都会丢掉工作。

sentences.en: Within her first two weeks at Club Casablanca,
sentences.zh: 在卡萨布兰卡俱乐部工作的头两周内，

sentences.en: Lucy gained a doting regular named Ken who visited her most days.
sentences.zh: 露西获得了一位名叫肯的忠实常客，他几乎每天都来看她。

sentences.en: But the pressure to gain more private requests than doughhand weighed on her heavily and exacerbated her insecurities.
sentences.zh: 但比起“同伴”约会，获得更多私人点名的压力让她倍感沉重，并加剧了她的不安全感。

sentences.en: She constantly compared herself to Louise, who she felt was getting far more attention from clients and adjusting better to their increasingly hectic social life outside of work.
sentences.zh: 她不断地拿自己和路易丝做比较，她觉得路易丝从客户那里得到了更多的关注，并且更好地适应了她们工作之外日益繁忙的社交生活。

sentences.en: Most nights after finishing at Casablanca,
sentences.zh: 在卡萨布兰卡俱乐部下班后的多数夜晚，

sentences.en: Lucy and Louise would descend into Roppongi's nightlife, dancing and drinking with other expats and travellers until the early hours.
sentences.zh: 露西和路易丝会沉浸在六本木的夜生活中，与其他外籍人士和游客一起跳舞喝酒，直到凌晨。

sentences.en: The cycle of working, partying and sleeping before doing it all again the next night began to exhaust Lucy.
sentences.zh: 这种工作、狂欢、睡觉，然后第二天晚上重复这一切的循环，开始让露西感到精疲力竭。

sentences.en: The working holiday to pay off her debts wasn't coming together at all like she had planned, and the pressure to earn more at the club through bonuses
sentences.zh: 为了偿还债务而进行的工作假期完全没有像她计划的那样进行，而通过奖金在俱乐部赚更多钱的压力，

sentences.en: was starting to become overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 开始变得让人难以承受。

sentences.en: On May 26, 2000, after three weeks in Japan,
sentences.zh: 2000年5月26日，在日本待了三周后，

sentences.en: Lucy confessed her feelings in her diary, writing,
sentences.zh: 露西在日记中吐露了自己的心声，写道：

sentences.en: I'm not coping well here.
sentences.zh: 我在这里过得并不好。

sentences.en: I can't pull myself out of this hole I've fallen into.
sentences.zh: 我无法把自己从陷入的这个深坑中拉出来。

sentences.en: I feel so ugly and fat and invisible in there, I constantly hate myself.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己在那里面又丑又胖，毫无存在感，我一直很讨厌自己。

sentences.en: I'm so fucking up to my neck in debt and so badly need to do well.
sentences.zh: 我他妈的债台高筑，真的非常需要成功。

sentences.en: But I'm a crap hostess.
sentences.zh: 但我是一个糟糕的陪酒女郎。

sentences.en: I'm so exhausted with feeling this shit and feeling so lonely.
sentences.zh: 我太累了，这种感觉糟透了，而且感到如此孤独。

sentences.en: I sometimes really can't be bothered to wait and find out what happens.
sentences.zh: 有时我真的懒得去等，去看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: I just want to disappear.
sentences.zh: 我只想消失。

sentences.en: By the start of July, after two months in Japan,
sentences.zh: 到了7月初，在日本待了两个月后，

sentences.en: Lucy was finally starting to feel more at ease with her new foreign life.
sentences.zh: 露西终于开始对她的新异国生活感到更加自在。

sentences.en: She had recently began dating a young US Navy Marine stationed in Tokyo named Scott, and her spirits lifted as she began to fall head over heels.
sentences.zh: 她最近开始和一名驻扎在东京的美国海军陆战队员斯科特约会，随着她坠入爱河，她的心情也随之好转。

sentences.en: The improvement in her mood seemed to have a positive impact on her hostessing as she gained more regular clients at Club Casablanca and secured several more Dohan dates.
sentences.zh: 她情绪的改善似乎对她的陪酒工作产生了积极影响，她在卡萨布兰卡俱乐部获得了更多的常客，并又安排了几次“同伴”约会。

sentences.en: Lucy seemed to be in a far better place and was starting to become more comfortable.
sentences.zh: 露西似乎处于一个好得多的状态，开始变得更加舒适。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Saturday July 1,
sentences.zh: 7月1日星期六下午，

sentences.en: Lucy received a call on the shared payphone at Sasaki House, where her and Louise were still living.
sentences.zh: 露西在佐佐木宅邸的公用付费电话上接到了一个电话，她和路易丝当时仍住在那儿。

sentences.en: The call was from a customer she had a prearranged Dohan lunch date with, who was calling to advise he was running late
sentences.zh: 电话是她一位预定了“同伴”午餐约会的客户打来的，他打电话通知说他要迟到了，

sentences.en: and would ring back when he was ready to meet her at the train station.
sentences.zh: 并说准备好在火车站见她时会再打给她。

sentences.en: A short while later, he called again to advise who was now 10 minutes away.
sentences.zh: 不久后，他又打来电话，通知说他现在离那儿还有10分钟路程。

sentences.en: Lucy didn't mention the man's name or say where they were going for their date, but she was excited because the customer had promised to give her a mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 露西没有提到那个男人的名字，也没有说他们要去哪里约会，但她很兴奋，因为客户答应送她一部手机。

sentences.en: She and Louise both had the night off from work, so they made a plan to meet up after Lucy's date later that evening.
sentences.zh: 她和路易丝当晚都不用上班，所以她们计划在露西当晚晚些时候约会结束后见面。

sentences.en: After making her way to Sendagaya Station to meet her date,
sentences.zh: 在前往千驮谷站与约会对象见面后，

sentences.en: Lucy called Louise from her unnamed customer's mobile phone at 5pm to let her know they were travelling to the seaside.
sentences.zh: 露西在下午5点用那位未透露姓名的客户的手机给路易丝打了电话，告诉她他们正前往海边。

sentences.en: She assured Louise she would still be home in time for their night out as planned.
sentences.zh: 她向路易丝保证，她会按计划及时赶回家参加她们的夜生活。

sentences.en: Just after 7pm, Louise received a second phone call from Lucy, advising she would be home within the hour.
sentences.zh: 晚上7点刚过，路易丝接到了露西的第二个电话，说她一小时内就会到家。

sentences.en: She was in good spirits, as this time she was calling from her new mobile phone gifted by her date, along with a bottle of champagne.
sentences.zh: 她心情很好，因为这次她是打着约会对象送她的新手机，还带着一瓶香槟。

sentences.en: Lucy then called her boyfriend Scott, but when there was no answer, she left a message advising she would meet up with him the following day.
sentences.zh: 露西随后给她的男友斯科特打了电话，但没人接听，于是她留了言，说第二天会和他见面。

sentences.en: Two hours went by and Lucy still hadn't returned home, causing Louise to become increasingly worried.
sentences.zh: 两个小时过去了，露西还是没有回家，这让路易丝越来越担心。

sentences.en: She went to Club Casablanca to report her concerns to co-workers, but they suggested that Lucy had simply decided to stay the night with her customer.
sentences.zh: 她去卡萨布兰卡俱乐部向同事报告了她的担忧，但他们建议说，露西可能只是决定和她的客户过夜。

sentences.en: Louise felt strongly that her friend would never do such a thing, so she had a Japanese-speaking co-worker call around to some of the bigger hospitals in the area
sentences.zh: 路易丝坚信她的朋友绝不会做这种事，于是她让一位会说日语的同事给该地区的一些大医院打了电话，

sentences.en: to check if anyone matching Lucy's description had been admitted.
sentences.zh: 询问是否有符合露西描述的人入院。

sentences.en: But there had been no sign of her.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何关于她的迹象。

sentences.en: Unable to sleep,
sentences.zh: 无法入睡，

sentences.en: Louise spent the night wandering around Roppongi, visiting the clubs and bars that she and Lucy frequented to ask if anyone had seen her friend.
sentences.zh: 路易丝整晚都在六本木徘徊，走访她和露西常去的俱乐部和酒吧，询问是否有人见过她的朋友。

sentences.en: No one had.
sentences.zh: 没有人见过。

sentences.en: Anxious about their illegal working status,
sentences.zh: 由于担心她们非法工作的身份，

sentences.en: Louise hesitated about going to the police, despite growing more and more panicked.
sentences.zh: 尽管越来越恐慌，路易丝还是对报警犹豫不决。

sentences.en: Lucy didn't return home or make contact during the remainder of the weekend.
sentences.zh: 周末剩下的时间里，露西没有回家，也没有联系任何人。

sentences.en: By the morning of Monday July 3,
sentences.zh: 到了7月3日星期一早上，

sentences.en: Louise, who was so stressed she had barely slept, finally filed a missing person report with the Azabu police station in Roppongi.
sentences.zh: 压力大到几乎没睡的路易丝终于在六本木的麻布警察署提交了一份失踪人口报告。

sentences.en: She didn't mention that Lucy had been working as a hostess and was attending a Dohan date, instead saying she had simply gone out on a day trip with a Japanese man she had met.
sentences.zh: 她没有提到露西一直在做陪酒女郎并参加“同伴”约会，而是说她只是和一个刚认识的日本男人去一日游了。

sentences.en: The police didn't seem overly concerned about the missing Westerner.
sentences.zh: 警方似乎对这位失踪的西方人并不太关心。

sentences.en: After all, Lucy was an independent adult who may have decided to continue travelling and had simply failed to notify anyone.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，露西是一个独立的成年人，可能决定继续旅行，只是没有通知任何人。

sentences.en: Disheartened by the lack of action,
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏行动而感到沮丧，

sentences.en: Louise then went to the British Embassy in Tokyo and admitted the whole truth, telling the Vice Consul about Lucy's illegal hostessing work
sentences.zh: 路易丝随后去了东京的英国大使馆，承认了全部真相，告诉副领事关于露西非法陪酒的工作，

sentences.en: and the fact she had gone to meet a customer on the day she was last seen.
sentences.zh: 以及她最后一次露面那天去见客户的事实。

sentences.en: The Embassy official was alarmed that the club would encourage such outings.
sentences.zh: 大使馆官员对俱乐部鼓励此类外出活动感到震惊。

sentences.en: The Vice Consul called Azabu police station to advise the Embassy was extremely concerned about Lucy's wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 副领事致电麻布警察署，告知大使馆对露西的安危极其担忧。

sentences.en: But despite telling police they feared Lucy had been abducted, the police still didn't seem overly concerned.
sentences.zh: 但尽管告诉警方他们担心露西被绑架，警方似乎仍然不太关心。

sentences.en: At approximately 5.30pm that afternoon,
sentences.zh: 那天下午大约5点30分，

sentences.en: Louise received a phone call on her mobile phone from an unknown man with a strong Japanese accent and a good command of English.
sentences.zh: 路易丝的手机接到了一个陌生男子的电话，他有着浓重的日本口音，英语说得很好。

sentences.en: The caller, who identified himself as Akira Takagi, said he was calling on behalf of Lucy.
sentences.zh: 打电话的人自称是高木明，说他是代表露西打来的。

sentences.en: He told Louise that the traffic had been bad on the night Lucy went missing, so she decided to take the train home instead of accepting a ride with her date.
sentences.zh: 他告诉路易丝，露西失踪那天交通状况很糟糕，所以她决定坐火车回家，而不是接受约会对象的搭车。

sentences.en: At the train station, she met a guru and on the spur of the moment decided to join his cult, the newly risen religion in the city of Chiba.
sentences.zh: 在火车站，她遇到了一位大师，一时冲动决定加入他的邪教，这是千叶市新近兴起的宗教。

sentences.en: Bewildered, Louise asked to speak to Lucy, but Akira said she wasn't feeling well and didn't want to talk to anyone.
sentences.zh: 路易丝感到困惑，要求和露西通话，但高木说她身体不舒服，不想和任何人说话。

sentences.en: Although she might want to talk later in the week.
sentences.zh: 虽然她可能想在周内晚些时候再谈。

sentences.en: He hung up abruptly, but called back moments later, explaining that Lucy had started a new life and wouldn't be coming back.
sentences.zh: 他突然挂断了电话，但片刻后又打了回来，解释说露西已经开始了新的生活，不会再回来了。

sentences.en: He said she was now paying her debts back in a better way and wanted her friends to know she was okay.
sentences.zh: 他说她现在正在以一种更好的方式偿还债务，并希望她的朋友们知道她很好。

sentences.en: Akira then asked Louise for her address in Japan as he needed to send some of Lucy's belongings back.
sentences.zh: 高木随后向路易丝询问她在日本的地址，因为他需要寄回露西的一些物品。

sentences.en: Louise evaded this request and in a bid to gain more information, asked if she too could join the cult.
sentences.zh: 路易丝回避了这个请求，为了获得更多信息，她问自己是否也能加入这个邪教。

sentences.en: She pleaded to speak to Lucy, but Akira ended the call, stating,
sentences.zh: 她恳求和露西通话，但高木结束了通话，说道：

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I just had to let you know that you won't be seeing her again.
sentences.zh: 对不起，我只是不得不让你知道，你不会再见到她了。

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Terrified, Louise returned to the British Embassy where she was advised to go back to the police station and admit the whole truth about what Lucy had been doing when she vanished.
sentences.zh: 惊恐万状的路易丝回到英国大使馆，在那里她被建议回到警察局，承认露西失踪时到底在做什么的全部真相。

sentences.en: Later that same night, a teary and distressed Louise finally worked up the courage to call Lucy's family in England to advise them of her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 当天深夜，泪流满面、心烦意乱的路易丝终于鼓起勇气给英国的露西家人打了电话，告知了她的失踪。

sentences.en: Lucy's mother, Jane Steer, had been preparing a care package to send to Japan, containing some of her daughter's favourite sweets and cosmetics, when she answered the call.
sentences.zh: 露西的母亲简·斯蒂尔当时正在准备一个寄往日本的爱心包裹，里面装着她女儿最喜欢的一些糖果和化妆品，这时她接到了电话。

sentences.en: As she began to absorb the bizarre news that Lucy was missing and had allegedly joined a Japanese cult, a group of Lucy's friends and her two younger siblings,
sentences.zh: 当她开始消化露西失踪并据称加入了日本邪教这一离奇消息时，露西的一群朋友和她的两个弟弟妹妹，

sentences.en: sister Sophie and brother Rupert, gathered at Jane's home to offer their support and figure out what to do next.
sentences.zh: 妹妹索菲和弟弟鲁珀特，聚集在简的家中提供支持，并商量下一步该怎么办。

sentences.en: Lucy's father, Tim Blackman, who had not spoken to his ex-wife since their divorce several years earlier, was also notified.
sentences.zh: 露西的父亲蒂姆·布莱克曼，自几年前离婚后就没再和前妻说过话，也得到了通知。

sentences.en: Those close to Lucy were certain the story that she had joined a cult was a complete fabrication.
sentences.zh: 露西身边的人都确信她加入了邪教的故事完全是捏造的。

sentences.en: They feared she had met with foul play.
sentences.zh: 他们担心她遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: Lucy's 20-year-old sister Sophie and ex-boyfriend Jamie decided to fly to Tokyo immediately to begin searching for her.
sentences.zh: 露西20岁的妹妹索菲和前男友杰米决定立即飞往东京开始寻找她。

sentences.en: Lucy's mother, Jane, didn't want to leave her teenage son Rupert alone in the UK, so she made the tough decision to stay at home.
sentences.zh: 露西的母亲简不想把十几岁的儿子鲁珀特独自留在英国，所以她做出了留在国内的艰难决定。

sentences.en: On July 4, three days since Lucy had failed to return from her Dohan date,
sentences.zh: 7月4日，距离露西未能从“同伴”约会中回来已经过去了三天，

sentences.en: Sophie and Jamie departed for Tokyo, where they spent a week paying multiple visits to the British Embassy and to the Azabu police station in Roppongi.
sentences.zh: 索菲和杰米启程前往东京，在那里他们花了一周时间多次访问英国大使馆和六本木的麻布警察署。

sentences.en: None of the visits proved helpful, as the police treated their concerns with the same indifference they had shown Louise.
sentences.zh: 所有的访问都没有起到任何作用，因为警方对待他们的担忧和对待路易丝时一样冷漠。

sentences.en: Faced with the inaction of local police,
sentences.zh: 面对当地警方的无所作为，

sentences.en: Sophie spoke with her father, Tim Blackman, in the UK and discussed going public with Lucy's story
sentences.zh: 索菲与在英国的父亲蒂姆·布莱克曼进行了交谈，讨论将露西的故事公之于众。

sentences.en: and enlisting the help of the media to gain interest and help for her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 并寻求媒体的帮助，以引起关注并为寻找她的下落提供助力。

sentences.en: Although they all held concerns that going public may have an adverse impact and cause Lucy's abductor to panic and harm or kill her.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们都担心公开此事可能会产生负面影响，导致露西的绑架者惊慌失措，进而伤害或杀害她。

sentences.en: In the end, the decision was made for them, as back in London, Louise's sister, Emma Phillips, had already taken the story to British newspaper The Daily Telegraph.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们别无选择，因为远在伦敦，露西的姐姐艾玛·菲利普斯已经将这个故事告诉了英国《每日电讯报》。

sentences.en: With the media now notified,
sentences.zh: 随着媒体的介入，

sentences.en: Lucy's disappearance was quickly plastered throughout UK papers.
sentences.zh: 露西失踪的消息迅速登上了英国各大报纸的头条。

sentences.en: Despite the public attention,
sentences.zh: 尽管受到了公众的关注，

sentences.en: Tokyo police continued to show little interest in pursuing an investigation.
sentences.zh: 东京警方对开展调查仍表现得兴致缺缺。

sentences.en: Frustrated, the Blackman family decided to embrace the media attention to its fullest, in the hopes their efforts would compel someone with information to come forward.
sentences.zh: 布莱克曼一家感到非常沮丧，决定充分利用媒体的关注，希望他们的努力能促使知情者站出来。

sentences.en: On July 12, 11 days into Lucy's disappearance, her father, Tim Blackman, made the overseas journey to join the search and raise media awareness.
sentences.zh: 7月12日，在露西失踪的第11天，她的父亲蒂姆·布莱克曼远渡重洋，加入搜寻工作并提升媒体关注度。

sentences.en: The next day, Tim and his daughter Sophie held their first press conference at the British Embassy in Tokyo, imploring anyone who had seen Lucy to contact police.
sentences.zh: 第二天，蒂姆和他的女儿苏菲在英国驻东京大使馆举行了首次新闻发布会，恳求任何见过露西的人联系警方。

sentences.en: Reports that Lucy suddenly abandoned her life to join a cult seemed unlikely to her family, as she had never demonstrated much interest in religion.
sentences.zh: 关于露西突然抛弃生活去加入邪教的说法，她的家人认为不太可能，因为她从未表现出对宗教的浓厚兴趣。

sentences.en: They also rejected claims she may have run away to escape her credit card debts, describing the amount of money she owed as manageable.
sentences.zh: 他们还驳斥了她可能为了逃避信用卡债务而潜逃的说法，称她所欠的金额完全在可控范围内。

sentences.en: During a subsequent press conference,
sentences.zh: 在随后的新闻发布会上，

sentences.en: Tim issued a passionate plea to Lucy's abductor to release his daughter.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆向露西的绑架者发出了深情的恳求，希望他能释放自己的女儿。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: We are all starting to feel very desperate and upset that Lucy is kept somewhere in difficult conditions where she will be extremely upset herself.
sentences.zh: 我们都开始感到非常绝望和难过，因为露西被关在某个环境恶劣的地方，她自己一定也极其痛苦。

sentences.en: I therefore, as her father, beg of them humbly to please just release her to us again.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为父亲，我卑微地恳求他们，请把她放回来。

sentences.en: I just can't begin to describe to this person or these people the devastating sorrow we've been through and how we are being torn apart by Lucy being held away from us.
sentences.zh: 我无法向这个人或这些人描述我们所经历的毁灭性悲痛，以及露西被强行与我们分离所带来的撕心裂肺的痛苦。

sentences.en: After this emotional display, media interest in the story intensified and British reporters arrived to Japan in droves to interview Tim and Sophie,
sentences.zh: 在这次情感流露之后，媒体对该事件的关注度激增，英国记者蜂拥至日本采访蒂姆和苏菲，

sentences.en: the father and daughter appearing on multiple TV shows in both the UK and Japan.
sentences.zh: 这对父女出现在了英国和日本的多档电视节目中。

sentences.en: With the increased media attention putting pressure on the police to act, the Tokyo Metropolitan Police upgraded Lucy's disappearance to a criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 随着媒体关注度的提高，警方承受了行动压力，东京警视厅将露西的失踪案升级为刑事案件。

sentences.en: While out to dinner one night,
sentences.zh: 一天晚上外出用餐时，

sentences.en: Tim and Sophie Blackman were approached by a wealthy British expat named Hugh Shakeshaft, who recognised them from their many media appearances
sentences.zh: 一位名叫休·谢克沙夫的富有英国侨民主动接近了蒂姆和苏菲·布莱克曼，因为他在多次媒体报道中认出了他们，

sentences.en: as he had been following Lucy's disappearance closely.
sentences.zh: 他一直密切关注着露西的失踪案。

sentences.en: Hugh generously donated a £100,000 reward for information and offered the Blackmans the use of his business officers in Roppongi as their operational base.
sentences.zh: 休慷慨地捐出10万英镑作为悬赏金，并提议布莱克曼一家使用他在六本木的商务办公室作为行动基地。

sentences.en: Tim and Sophie used this opportunity to set up the Lucy Blackman hotline, where people who were hesitant about going to the police could call in with information.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆和苏菲利用这个机会设立了“露西·布莱克曼热线”，让那些对直接报警有顾虑的人可以通过电话提供信息。

sentences.en: Offers of assistance poured in from the UK, with the Virgin Atlantic Airline conglomerate financing the advertisement of the hotline number.
sentences.zh: 来自英国的援助纷至沓来，维珍大西洋航空公司资助了热线号码的广告宣传。

sentences.en: Virgin's founder, Sir Richard Branson, also offered financial assistance in the search.
sentences.zh: 维珍创始人理查德·布兰森爵士也为搜寻工作提供了经济援助。

sentences.en: The hotline, which was staffed by expats, began operation 21 days into the search for Lucy.
sentences.zh: 这条由外籍人士负责运营的热线，在搜寻露西的第21天正式投入使用。

sentences.en: Calls came flooding in, with many witnesses reporting seeing the missing 21-year-old, but they had simply mistaken other blonde Western women for Lucy.
sentences.zh: 电话接连不断，许多目击者报告说看到了这位失踪的21岁女孩，但他们只是把其他金发西方女性误认成了露西。

sentences.en: The answering machine for the hotline also recorded many bizarre messages, including laughter, strange rants and incoherent mumbling.
sentences.zh: 热线的电话录音机也记录下了许多奇怪的留言，包括笑声、奇怪的咆哮和含糊不清的嘟囔。

sentences.en: Police interviewed Lucy's US Marine boyfriend, Scott, as a person of interest, but he had been aboard a naval ship on the day of her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 警方将露西的美国海军陆战队男友斯科特作为嫌疑人进行了审问，但他在露西失踪当天正身处一艘海军舰艇上。

sentences.en: Lucy's regular customer at Club Casablanca, Ken, was also interviewed, but he too was eliminated as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 露西在卡萨布兰卡俱乐部的常客肯也接受了审问，但他也被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: Between July 21 and 23, the 26th annual G8 Summit was held on the Japanese island of Okinawa,
sentences.zh: 7月21日至23日，第26届八国集团峰会在日本冲绳岛举行，

sentences.en: where world leaders from eight different countries, including the United Kingdom and Japan, came together to discuss a range of global issues.
sentences.zh: 来自包括英国和日本在内的八个国家的领导人齐聚一堂，讨论了一系列全球性问题。

sentences.en: Prior to the G8 Summit, British Prime Minister Tony Blair agreed to meet with Tim Blackman to discuss Lucy's disappearance and gain an understanding of the issues
sentences.zh: 在八国集团峰会之前，英国首相托尼·布莱尔同意会见蒂姆·布莱克曼，讨论露西的失踪案，并了解

sentences.en: the family were facing in their efforts to find her.
sentences.zh: 该家庭在寻找她时所面临的问题。

sentences.en: This conversation prompted Tony Blair to discuss the case directly with Japanese Prime Minister
sentences.zh: 这次谈话促使托尼·布莱尔直接与日本首相

sentences.en: Yoshiro Mori, which propelled the Tokyo Metropolitan Police into further action.
sentences.zh: 森喜朗讨论了此案，这推动了东京警视厅采取进一步行动。

sentences.en: A large number of detectives were assigned to the case, and 30,000 missing person posters featuring a photograph of Lucy sitting on a sofa wearing
sentences.zh: 大量侦探被分配到此案，3万张印有露西坐在沙发上、身穿

sentences.en: a black dress were distributed throughout Japan.
sentences.zh: 黑色连衣裙照片的寻人启事在全日本散发。

sentences.en: The poster used bilingual text in both Japanese and English to describe the 21-year-old,
sentences.zh: 海报使用日语和英语双语描述了这位21岁的女孩，

sentences.en: and urged anyone who had seen Lucy or had any information to contact their nearest police station.
sentences.zh: 并敦促任何见过露西或有任何信息的人联系最近的警察局。

sentences.en: A police spokesperson told the media, quote, We are involved in a very difficult investigation, since we have yet to obtain a single tip that has led us to a major breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 一位警方发言人告诉媒体：“我们正在进行一项非常困难的调查，因为我们尚未获得任何能让我们取得重大突破的线索。”

sentences.en: Tim and Sophie, with assistance from generous volunteers, walked the streets of Tokyo handing out the missing person flyers, urging passers-by to come forward with any information.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆和苏菲在慷慨的志愿者的帮助下，走遍了东京街头分发寻人传单，敦促路人提供任何信息。

sentences.en: On August 1, one month after Lucy's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 8月1日，在露西失踪一个月后，

sentences.en: Tokyo police received a typed letter allegedly written by the missing 21-year-old.
sentences.zh: 东京警方收到了一封据称由这位失踪的21岁女孩亲笔书写的打印信件。

sentences.en: The letter insisted she was fine, urging her family not to worry and to return to England where she would call them later.
sentences.zh: 信中坚称她很好，敦促家人不要担心，并让他们回英国，她稍后会给他们打电话。

sentences.en: However, it appeared that whoever wrote the letter was not a native English speaker, as it was filled with all kinds of linguistic and grammatical errors,
sentences.zh: 然而，写这封信的人似乎并非英语母语者，因为信中充满了各种语言和语法错误，

sentences.en: with police promptly dismissing it as a hoax.
sentences.zh: 警方当即将其斥为恶作剧。

sentences.en: On August 4, an exhausted Tim Blackman returned home to the United Kingdom, leaving Sophie in Japan to continue the search for her sister.
sentences.zh: 8月4日，疲惫不堪的蒂姆·布莱克曼回到了英国，留下苏菲在日本继续寻找她的姐姐。

sentences.en: Despite police increasing their efforts, they continued to leave Lucy's family in the dark about any progress in the investigation.
sentences.zh: 尽管警方加大了力度，但他们继续对露西的家人隐瞒调查进展。

sentences.en: Soon after Tim arrived home, he received a startling phone call from a British man named Mike Hills, who lived in Holland and claimed to have contacts in the Japanese underworld.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆刚回到家不久，就接到了一个名叫迈克·希尔斯的英国男子的惊人电话，此人住在荷兰，声称在日本黑社会有门路。

sentences.en: Mike said these figures had a vested interest in finding Lucy, as the resulting police pressure was impacting arms dealers and other Yakuza members
sentences.zh: 迈克说，这些人有寻找露西的既得利益，因为随之而来的警察压力正在影响军火商和其他黑帮成员

sentences.en: from effectively conducting their unlawful business.
sentences.zh: 无法有效地进行非法生意。

sentences.en: To ensure their dealings resumed to normal, these gang members were willing to try and find Lucy, but their assistance came with a price.
sentences.zh: 为了确保他们的交易恢复正常，这些帮派成员愿意尝试寻找露西，但他们的帮助是有代价的。

sentences.en: Tim arranged to meet with Mike Hills, but before the meeting,
sentences.zh: 蒂姆安排与迈克·希尔斯见面，但在会面之前，

sentences.en: Mike called back with the news that one of his contacts had discovered Lucy was alive.
sentences.zh: 迈克打来电话说，他的一位线人发现露西还活着。

sentences.en: She had been kidnapped and sold by a group involved in the trafficking of foreign women.
sentences.zh: 她被一个涉及贩卖外国女性的团伙绑架并卖掉了。

sentences.en: This contact could find Lucy and buy her back for the price of $50,000.
sentences.zh: 这位线人可以找到露西并以5万美元的价格把她买回来。

sentences.en: Tim was deeply unsure about Mike's claim, but was willing to take any chance to find his daughter.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆对迈克的说法深表怀疑，但为了找到女儿，他愿意冒任何风险。

sentences.en: The two men met, and Mike explained Tim would have to make an on-the-spot payment of $12,500 to secure the deal.
sentences.zh: 两人见面后，迈克解释说，蒂姆必须当场支付1.25万美元才能达成交易。

sentences.en: He would then need to travel to Japan to hand over an additional $25,000, followed by a final payment of $12,500 to be paid once Lucy was safely returned.
sentences.zh: 然后他需要前往日本再支付2.5万美元，最后在露西安全返回后支付1.25万美元的尾款。

sentences.en: Tim paid the $12,500 in cash as instructed, and quickly made his way back to Japan.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆按指示支付了1.25万美元现金，并迅速赶回日本。

sentences.en: Upon his arrival, Mike's story took a turn.
sentences.zh: 他抵达后，迈克的故事发生了反转。

sentences.en: Lucy was no longer in Japan, but had been smuggled out on a ship and was on her way to Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 露西已经不在日本了，而是被偷运上一艘船，正在前往香港的途中。

sentences.en: The ship could be intercepted, but it would require an additional payment of $10,000.
sentences.zh: 这艘船可以被拦截，但需要额外支付1万美元。

sentences.en: Desperate to save Lucy,
sentences.zh: 为了救露西，

sentences.en: Tim handed over the money.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆交出了这笔钱。

sentences.en: Following this transaction,
sentences.zh: 在这笔交易之后，

sentences.en: Mike's story constantly changed.
sentences.zh: 迈克的故事不断变化。

sentences.en: He continued to ask for more money, despite seeming to be no closer to retrieving Lucy.
sentences.zh: 他继续索要更多的钱，尽管看起来离找回露西并没有更近一步。

sentences.en: Eventually, the calls from Mike Hills stopped entirely, and Tim was unable to contact him, leading to the stark realisation that the vulnerable father had been conned.
sentences.zh: 最终，迈克·希尔斯的电话完全中断了，蒂姆无法联系到他，这让他清醒地意识到这位脆弱的父亲被骗了。

sentences.en: Tim reported his experience to police, who discovered Mike Hills had an extensive criminal history for deception and theft,
sentences.zh: 蒂姆向警方报告了他的遭遇，警方发现迈克·希尔斯有大量的欺诈和盗窃犯罪记录，

sentences.en: having also scammed another English family whose son had gone missing in South America.
sentences.zh: 他还曾诈骗过另一个儿子在南美失踪的英国家庭。

sentences.en: For his lies to both families,
sentences.zh: 因为对两个家庭撒谎，

sentences.en: Mike Hills was later charged with obtaining property by deception and sentenced to three and a half years in prison.
sentences.zh: 迈克·希尔斯后来被控以欺骗手段获取财产，并被判处三年半监禁。

sentences.en: Of the scam,
sentences.zh: 谈到这场骗局，

sentences.en: Tim Blackman later said,
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·布莱克曼后来表示：

sentences.en: Throughout August,
sentences.zh: 整个八月，

sentences.en: Tim and Sophie Blackman continued to travel back and forth between Japan and the UK, manning the hotline and spending time in the hostess bars of Roppongi,
sentences.zh: 蒂姆和苏菲·布莱克曼继续往返于日本和英国之间，管理热线并花时间在六本木的陪酒俱乐部，

sentences.en: seeking any information that might lead them to Lucy.
sentences.zh: 寻找任何可能引导他们找到露西的信息。

sentences.en: The dark side of Japan's hostessing industry soon came to light, as they heard many harrowing stories of foreign hostesses who had gone missing
sentences.zh: 日本陪酒行业的阴暗面很快浮出水面，因为他们听到了许多关于外国陪酒女失踪的悲惨故事，

sentences.en: or experienced violence at the hands of customers.
sentences.zh: 或者她们在顾客手中遭受暴力的经历。

sentences.en: Three years prior to Lucy's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 在露西失踪的三年前，

sentences.en: 27-year-old Canadian hostess Tiffany Fordham disappeared after she was last seen with a customer in the elevator of a Roppongi nightclub.
sentences.zh: 27岁的加拿大陪酒女蒂芙尼·福特汉姆在六本木一家夜总会的电梯里与一名顾客最后一次露面后失踪。

sentences.en: She was never seen again, with police conducting no efforts to find her.
sentences.zh: 她再也没有出现过，警方也没有采取任何努力去寻找她。

sentences.en: Other foreign hostesses reported incidents where customers had taken advantage of them during Dohan dates, with reports of drink spiking, violence and rape.
sentences.zh: 其他外国陪酒女也报告了顾客在“同伴约会”中占她们便宜的事件，包括下药、暴力和强奸。

sentences.en: As most hostesses were working illegally, a majority of these incidents were not reported to police, and the ones that were, were rarely taken seriously.
sentences.zh: 由于大多数陪酒女是非法工作的，这些事件大多没有向警方报告，而那些报告了的也极少受到重视。

sentences.en: September 1 marked two months since Lucy Blackman left for her Dohan date and had never returned.
sentences.zh: 9月1日，距离露西·布莱克曼去参加“同伴约会”后一去不返已经过去了两个月。

sentences.en: Back in the UK, her mother Jane and younger brother Rupert released 1,000 balloons over the cricket ground of Lucy's hometown to commemorate her 22nd birthday.
sentences.zh: 在英国，她的母亲简和弟弟鲁珀特在露西家乡的板球场放飞了1000个气球，以纪念她的22岁生日。

sentences.en: As the month wore on, Lucy's family became increasingly despondent.
sentences.zh: 随着月份的推移，露西的家人变得越来越沮丧。

sentences.en: They boosted the reward money for information in an attempt to generate new leads, but all this did was increase the number of false sightings placed to the hotline.
sentences.zh: 他们提高了悬赏金以试图产生新的线索，但这只会增加打到热线的虚假目击报告数量。

sentences.en: Despite all their efforts, nobody seemed to have any information about Lucy's last movements or her whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们付出了所有努力，似乎没有人有关于露西最后动向或下落的任何信息。

sentences.en: Tensions began to rise between the Blackmans and Tokyo Police, who insisted technical difficulties and complicated laws regarding the disclosure of private information
sentences.zh: 布莱克曼一家与东京警方之间的紧张关系开始升级，警方坚称技术困难和关于披露私人信息的复杂法律

sentences.en: was stopping them from obtaining phone records from the caller who rang Louise on July 3, advising that Lucy had spontaneously joined a cult.
sentences.zh: 阻止了他们从7月3日给路易丝打电话、告知露西自愿加入邪教的来电者那里获取电话记录。

sentences.en: They eventually said they were obtaining a court order to gain access to the records, but advised Lucy's family to be patient, as it would take some time.
sentences.zh: 他们最终表示正在申请法院命令以获取这些记录，但建议露西的家人保持耐心，因为这需要一些时间。

sentences.en: In late September, Lucy's mother Jane travelled to Tokyo and gave a press conference in which she implored Lucy's captor to release her daughter
sentences.zh: 9月下旬，露西的母亲简前往东京并举行了新闻发布会，恳求露西的绑架者释放她的女儿，

sentences.en: and begged anyone with information to come forward, stating,
sentences.zh: 并恳求任何有信息的人站出来，她说：

sentences.en: By early October, Lucy's family were overwhelmed with all kinds of challenges.
sentences.zh: 到10月初，露西的家人被各种挑战压得喘不过气来。

sentences.en: Their makeshift operations centre at the offices provided by Hugh Shakeshaft had fallen apart, as Hugh felt Tim Blackman had abused his hospitality by disrespecting his staff,
sentences.zh: 他们在休·谢克沙夫提供的办公室里设立的临时行动中心已经解散，因为休觉得蒂姆·布莱克曼不尊重他的员工，滥用了他的好客，

sentences.en: ordering expensive dinners on his tab, and constantly inviting members of the media into the office for interviews, despite specifically being asked not to.
sentences.zh: 在他的账单上点昂贵的晚餐，并且尽管被明确要求不要这样做，还是不断邀请媒体成员进入办公室进行采访。

sentences.en: The relationship between Lucy's parents was also under strain, and their visits to Japan were strategically timed to avoid one another.
sentences.zh: 露西父母之间的关系也处于紧张状态，他们访问日本的时间经过精心安排，以避免见面。

sentences.en: This discord between the divorced couple spilled out during media interviews, putting increased stress on the family.
sentences.zh: 这对离异夫妇之间的不和在媒体采访中暴露出来，给这个家庭带来了更大的压力。

sentences.en: Having spent tens of thousands of pounds flying back and forth between Japan and the United Kingdom, they were also burdened with financial pressure.
sentences.zh: 由于花费了数万英镑往返于日本和英国之间，他们还背负着沉重的经济压力。

sentences.en: Exhausted and tired of feeling like the Tokyo police were intentionally shutting them out,
sentences.zh: 精疲力竭，厌倦了感觉东京警方在故意将他们拒之门外，

sentences.en: Lucy's mother, father, and sister felt they had hit a brick wall in their efforts.
sentences.zh: 露西的母亲、父亲和姐姐感到他们在努力中碰了壁。

sentences.en: Reluctantly, they each departed Japan and returned home.
sentences.zh: 他们不情愿地各自离开了日本，回到了家。

sentences.en: But unbeknownst to the family, their heavy media presence had actually paid off.
sentences.zh: 但家人不知道的是，他们强大的媒体曝光度实际上已经收到了回报。

sentences.en: Two witnesses had come forward to police offering information.
sentences.zh: 两名目击者已经向警方提供了信息。

sentences.en: One of the witnesses who came forward was an American woman who had been working as a hostess in Roppongi in 1997.
sentences.zh: 其中一名站出来的目击者是一位美国女性，她曾于1997年在六本木担任陪酒女。

sentences.en: As part of her duties, she agreed to visit a customer named Koji at the Zushi Marina Apartment Complex in the seaside town of Zushi, located an hour's train ride from Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 作为职责的一部分，她同意去拜访一位名叫“浩二”的顾客，地点位于距离东京一小时火车车程的海滨小镇逗子的逗子码头公寓大楼。

sentences.en: After taking a sip of a drink Koji offered to her, the woman blacked out and awoke sick on the couch many hours later,
sentences.zh: 在喝了一口浩二递给她的饮料后，这名女子失去了知觉，许多小时后在沙发上醒来时感到恶心，

sentences.en: wearing nothing but her underwear, with no memory of anything that had happened.
sentences.zh: 身上只穿着内衣，对发生的一切毫无记忆。

sentences.en: Koji explained there had been a gas leak which had caused her to lose consciousness, but the woman suspected she had been drugged.
sentences.zh: 浩二解释说是因为煤气泄漏导致她失去知觉，但该女子怀疑自己被下了药。

sentences.en: She reported the incident to the Azabu police station with help from her employer,
sentences.zh: 在雇主的帮助下，她向麻布警察局报告了这起事件，

sentences.en: providing a description of Koji's appearance, the location of his apartment, and his mobile phone number.
sentences.zh: 提供了浩二的外貌描述、他公寓的位置以及他的手机号码。

sentences.en: But her report was met with indifference.
sentences.zh: 但她的报告遭到了冷遇。

sentences.en: She later described her ordeal in Richard Lloyd Parry's book, People Who Eat Darkness.
sentences.zh: 她后来在理查德·劳埃德·帕里的书《吃黑暗的人》中描述了她的遭遇。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 她说：

sentences.en: The officers showed no interest whatsoever to help or take any further action.
sentences.zh: 警察对提供帮助或采取进一步行动毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: They said they could not investigate my incident because of a lack of evidence.
sentences.zh: 他们说因为缺乏证据，无法调查我的事件。

sentences.en: I was made to feel as if I were a nuisance and wasting police time.
sentences.zh: 我被弄得好像是一个麻烦，在浪费警察的时间。

sentences.en: Three years later, the woman was still living in Tokyo when she heard about Lucy Blackman's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 三年后，这名女子仍住在东京，当时她听说了露西·布莱克曼失踪的消息。

sentences.en: Reminded of her ordeal in Zushi years earlier, she immediately returned to the Azabu police station to report concerns that the same man who attacked her
sentences.zh: 回想起多年前在逗子的遭遇，她立即回到麻布警察局，报告了她的担忧，即那个袭击她的人

sentences.en: could be the customer Lucy had visited on the day she vanished.
sentences.zh: 可能就是露西失踪当天拜访的那位顾客。

sentences.en: The American woman wasn't the only former hostess who provided police with information.
sentences.zh: 这位美国女性并不是唯一向警方提供信息的前陪酒女。

sentences.en: In 1995, a Scottish expat went on a series of extravagant Dohan dates with a wealthy customer who called himself Yuji Honda.
sentences.zh: 1995年，一位苏格兰侨民与一位自称“本田裕二”的富有顾客进行了一系列奢华的“同伴约会”。

sentences.en: One night, Yuji took his hostess to his seaside apartment where he asked her to drink a rare wine.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，裕二把他的陪酒女带到他的海滨公寓，让她喝一种稀有的葡萄酒。

sentences.en: More than 12 hours later, she awoke in his apartment with no memory of what had happened.
sentences.zh: 12个多小时后，她在他的公寓里醒来，对发生的事情毫无记忆。

sentences.en: She decided not to report the incident to police, but held on to Yuji's mobile phone number just in case.
sentences.zh: 她决定不向警方报告这起事件，但还是留下了裕二的手机号码以防万一。

sentences.en: Five years later, when this woman heard about Lucy Blackman's disappearance, she travelled from her home in Osaka to the Azabu police station to report her concerns
sentences.zh: 五年后，当这名女子听说露西·布莱克曼失踪的消息时，她从大阪的家中前往麻布警察局报告她的担忧，

sentences.en: that the man she knew as Yuji Honda could be involved.
sentences.zh: 即她所认识的本田裕二可能牵涉其中。

sentences.en: Although she felt her statement was met with disinterest, several other hostesses also came forward to report similar experiences,
sentences.zh: 尽管她觉得自己的陈述遭到了冷遇，但其他几位陪酒女也站出来报告了类似的经历，

sentences.en: ensuring police could no longer ignore the similarities between witness accounts.
sentences.zh: 确保警方再也不能忽视目击者陈述之间的相似之处。

sentences.en: Police were also finally granted warrants to access telephone records and were able to trace two calls.
sentences.zh: 警方最终也获得了访问电话记录的搜查令，并能够追踪到两个电话。

sentences.en: The one made by Lucy's customer to the Sasaki House payphone on the morning of her disappearance,
sentences.zh: 一个是露西的顾客在失踪当天早上打到佐佐木家公用电话的，

sentences.en: and the call Lucy placed to her friend Louise from her customer's mobile phone on the afternoon she vanished.
sentences.zh: 另一个是露西在失踪当天下午用顾客的手机打给朋友路易丝的。

sentences.en: Both calls were traced to a mobile phone that had been purchased using a fake name.
sentences.zh: 这两个电话都被追踪到一部使用假名购买的手机上。

sentences.en: Further analysis of the phone records determined both calls were made from the Zushi Marina apartment complex,
sentences.zh: 对电话记录的进一步分析确定，这两个电话都是从逗子码头公寓大楼打出的，

sentences.en: the same location the American former hostess had identified as the building where she was drugged back in 1997 by a man she identified as Koji.
sentences.zh: 这正是那位美国前陪酒女在1997年被一个她确认为“浩二”的男子下药的那栋大楼。

sentences.en: Several other hostesses also identified the Zushi Marina as the location they were drugged and stripped naked,
sentences.zh: 其他几位陪酒女也确认逗子码头是她们被下药并剥光衣服的地方，

sentences.en: but none were able to remember the exact building or apartment number the incidents occurred.
sentences.zh: 但没有人能记得事件发生的具体楼栋或公寓号码。

sentences.en: Police searched the criminal records of all apartment owners within the complex, looking for anyone who had a history of sexual offences.
sentences.zh: 警方搜查了该大楼内所有公寓业主的犯罪记录，寻找任何有性犯罪前科的人。

sentences.en: They made a startling discovery.
sentences.zh: 他们有了惊人的发现。

sentences.en: 48-year-old Joji Ibarra was a wealthy property developer and business owner who had been arrested in 1998 for attempting to videotape unsuspecting women in public toilets.
sentences.zh: 48岁的织原城二是一位富有的房地产开发商和企业主，他曾于1998年因试图在公共厕所偷拍毫无防备的女性而被捕。

sentences.en: He pled guilty to the crime and was issued with a small fine.
sentences.zh: 他对罪行供认不讳，并被处以小额罚款。

sentences.en: When police showed Joji's mugshot to the hostesses who had come forward claiming to have been drugged and assaulted, they unanimously identified Joji Ibarra as their attacker.
sentences.zh: 当警方将织原的照片展示给那些站出来声称被下药和袭击的陪酒女看时，她们一致指认织原城二就是袭击者。

sentences.en: Police obtained CCTV footage that revealed a luxury vehicle registered to Joji Ibarra had travelled to Tokyo on the day Lucy Blackman went missing.
sentences.zh: 警方获得了闭路电视录像，显示一辆登记在织原城二名下的豪华轿车在露西·布莱克曼失踪当天前往了东京。

sentences.en: Police now felt confident they had identified their prime suspect, but needed concrete evidence before they could make an arreSt.
sentences.zh: 警方现在确信他们已经锁定了主要嫌疑人，但在实施逮捕前还需要确凿的证据。

sentences.en: Further investigation into Ibarra revealed he also owned a property in the Blue Sea apartment complex on the Mura Peninsula,
sentences.zh: 进一步调查显示，伊原还在三浦半岛的蓝海公寓大楼拥有一处房产，

sentences.en: a rugged coastline approximately 32 kilometres from Zushi.
sentences.zh: 那是一段距离逗子约32公里的崎岖海岸线。

sentences.en: Five days after Lucy's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 露西失踪五天后，

sentences.en: the apartment manager of the Blue Sea building had phoned police to report one of his residents had been making unusual sounds in his apartment.
sentences.zh: 蓝海公寓的经理曾致电警方，报告说有一名住户在公寓里发出异常声响。

sentences.en: Local police visited the apartment and found a shirtless Joji Ibarra dirty and covered in sweat with concrete residue on his hands.
sentences.zh: 当地警方前往该公寓，发现赤裸上身的城治·伊原浑身脏兮兮、大汗淋漓，手上还沾着混凝土残渣。

sentences.en: He allowed the officers to enter his home where they noticed chunks of cement were strewn about, along with a tool resembling a garden hoe and a sack containing a large item.
sentences.zh: 他允许警员进入家中，警员注意到屋内散落着水泥块，还有一个类似锄头的工具，以及一个装着大件物品的袋子。

sentences.en: Ibarra refused to let the officers inspect the rest of his apartment and as they had no warrant to proceed with a search, they left the property.
sentences.zh: 伊原拒绝让警员检查公寓的其他区域，由于他们没有搜查令，便离开了该处房产。

sentences.en: At the time, Lucy Blackman's disappearance hadn't even made the news, so attending officers had no reason to be overly suspicious of Ibarra.
sentences.zh: 当时，露西·布莱克曼失踪的消息甚至还没上新闻，所以到场的警员没有理由对伊原过度怀疑。

sentences.en: But now that he had become their prime suspect in Lucy's abduction, this bizarre incident became highly suspicious.
sentences.zh: 但现在他已成为露西绑架案的主要嫌疑人，这起离奇事件就变得非常可疑了。

sentences.en: Records revealed that Ibarra had recently purchased a boat, which stood out to investigators as unusual considering he had never owned one before
sentences.zh: 记录显示伊原最近买了一艘船，这让调查人员感到奇怪，因为他以前从未拥有过船，

sentences.en: and had no prior history of boating.
sentences.zh: 也没有任何航海经历。

sentences.en: Although there still wasn't enough evidence to arrest him in relation to Lucy Blackman's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 尽管当时还没有足够的证据以露西·布莱克曼失踪案为由逮捕他，

sentences.en: investigators became increasingly nervous that he may use this new boat to dispose of evidence.
sentences.zh: 但调查人员越来越担心他可能会利用这艘新船来销毁证据。

sentences.en: On October 12, police placed Joji Ibarra under arrest for five charges of rape for the reported assaults on other hostesses,
sentences.zh: 10月12日，警方以涉嫌对其他女公关进行袭击为由，对城治·伊原执行了五项强奸罪名的逮捕，

sentences.en: intending to billed their case against him for Lucy's abduction once he was in custody.
sentences.zh: 打算在他被拘留期间，进一步搜集他绑架露西的证据。

sentences.en: With Ibarra now under arrest, search warrants were granted for his many properties throughout Japan.
sentences.zh: 随着伊原被捕，警方获准对他名下在日本各地的多处房产进行搜查。

sentences.en: At his largest property, a decaying, neglected mansion in the Deninchofu district of southern Tokyo,
sentences.zh: 在他最大的房产——位于东京南部田园调布区的一栋破败、荒废的豪宅里，

sentences.en: police were confronted with a rubbish-strewn yard containing several disused luxury cars, including a Maserati, a classic early 1960s Aston Martin, and a Bentley.
sentences.zh: 警方看到院子里堆满了垃圾，还有几辆废弃的豪华轿车，包括一辆玛莎拉蒂、一辆经典的60年代早期阿斯顿·马丁和一辆宾利。

sentences.en: The house held decades of accumulated clutter, broken televisions, old car batteries, and dust-covered furniture.
sentences.zh: 房子里堆积了几十年的杂物，有坏掉的电视机、旧汽车电池和落满灰尘的家具。

sentences.en: A large freezer contained the frozen body of a dead dog, which Ibarra later explained had been his favourite pet.
sentences.zh: 一个大冰柜里装着一只死狗的尸体，伊原后来解释说那是他最宠爱的宠物。

sentences.en: He had frozen the body in the hopes that technological advancements would one day allow the dog to be restored to life or cloned.
sentences.zh: 他冷冻了尸体，是希望未来科技进步能让这只狗起死回生或进行克隆。

sentences.en: Included in piles of evidence seized from Ibarra's Deninchofu mansion and other properties
sentences.zh: 在从伊原的田园调布豪宅及其他房产中查获的成堆证据中，

sentences.en: were piles of diaries, notebooks, documents, videotapes, rolls of film, audio cassettes, and photographs.
sentences.zh: 包括成堆的日记、笔记本、文件、录像带、胶卷、录音带和照片。

sentences.en: The diaries and audio recordings dated all the way back to Ibarra's teenage years,
sentences.zh: 日记和录音记录一直追溯到伊原的青少年时期，

sentences.en: outlining in meticulous detail his sexual fetishes, fantasies, and experiences in what he referred to as conquest play.
sentences.zh: 详细记录了他的性癖好、幻想和经历，他称之为“征服游戏”。

sentences.en: Ibarra's records revealed a prolific sexual predator.
sentences.zh: 伊原的记录揭示了他是一个多产的性掠夺者。

sentences.en: His method of assaulting women was always the same.
sentences.zh: 他袭击女性的手法总是如出一辙。

sentences.en: He would pick up a hostess, or occasionally a woman who advertised in Lonely Hearts classified ads,
sentences.zh: 他会物色一名女公关，或者偶尔找那些在“寂寞芳心”分类广告中刊登信息的女性，

sentences.en: and would then covertly administer some sort of tranquiliser within her food or drink.
sentences.zh: 然后偷偷在她们的食物或饮料中下某种镇静剂。

sentences.en: If the woman had concerns about the strange taste, he would explain the drink was rare or the food contained special herbs.
sentences.zh: 如果女性对奇怪的味道产生怀疑，他就会解释说饮料很稀有，或者食物里加了特殊的草药。

sentences.en: Once the woman was rendered unconscious, he proceeded to rape her.
sentences.zh: 一旦女性失去知觉，他就开始实施强奸。

sentences.en: In one diary entry, Ibarra admitted he had no sexual interest in women who were conscious.
sentences.zh: 在一篇日记中，伊原承认他对清醒的女性没有性兴趣。

sentences.en: His diaries detailed the various drugs he used to render women unconscious, along with a rating of their effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 他的日记详细记录了他用来让女性昏迷的各种药物，并对药效进行了评级。

sentences.en: A dozen different types of drugs were recovered from his properties, including chloroform, sleeping pills, barbiturates, rehypnol, and GHB.
sentences.zh: 在他的房产中发现了十二种不同类型的药物，包括氯仿、安眠药、巴比妥类药物、氟硝西泮和GHB。

sentences.en: Joji Ibarra's prolific history as a violent sex offender was further evident within a large collection of videotapes dating back to the 1980s,
sentences.zh: 城治·伊原作为暴力性犯罪者的累累前科，在大量可追溯至20世纪80年代的录像带中得到了进一步证实，

sentences.en: many of which featured a woman's name written along the spine.
sentences.zh: 其中许多录像带的脊背上都写着女性的名字。

sentences.en: The tapes were recorded using a tripod-mounted camera, with bright lights capturing the full extent of Ibarra's depraved attacks.
sentences.zh: 这些录像带是用安装在三脚架上的摄像机拍摄的，明亮的灯光捕捉到了伊原卑劣行径的全过程。

sentences.en: Off camera, a television monitor displayed the assault so Ibarra could watch it as it was happening, while another played a pornographic film.
sentences.zh: 在镜头外，一台电视监视器显示着袭击过程，以便伊原在作案时观看，同时另一台播放着色情电影。

sentences.en: On camera, a naked Ibarra wore a mask that matched that worn by the fictional character Zorro.
sentences.zh: 在镜头里，赤裸的伊原戴着与虚构人物佐罗所戴面具相似的面具。

sentences.en: A strip of black fabric with holes cut for the eyes pulled across the upper face and tied at the back of the head.
sentences.zh: 那是一条黑色的布条，在眼睛处挖了孔，横跨在上半脸上，并在脑后系紧。

sentences.en: In the event that a woman stirred or awoke during an assault, Ibarra would administer a chemical-soaked rag over their mouth to once again render them unconscious.
sentences.zh: 如果女性在袭击过程中动弹或醒来，伊原就会用浸过化学药剂的抹布捂住她们的嘴，再次让她们昏迷。

sentences.en: When the woman awoke after the attack feeling disoriented and sick, often vomiting and unable to stand,
sentences.zh: 当女性在袭击后醒来，感到迷失方向和恶心，经常呕吐且无法站立时，

sentences.en: Ibarra would provide a vague explanation for how they came to pass out, including that there had been a gas leak or that the woman drank too much alcohol.
sentences.zh: 伊原会给出一个模糊的解释，说明她们为何昏倒，包括声称有煤气泄漏，或者说女性喝了太多酒。

sentences.en: The exact number of videotapes recovered by police is uncertain, with reports ranging from 200 to 1,000.
sentences.zh: 警方找回的录像带确切数量尚不确定，报告称在200到1000盘之间。

sentences.en: With the recorded names and videotape footage, police identified both the American and Scottish women who had come forward during the Lucy Blackman investigation,
sentences.zh: 通过记录的名字和录像片段，警方确认了在露西·布莱克曼调查期间挺身而出的美国和苏格兰女性，

sentences.en: and they were also able to trace many of the other survivors.
sentences.zh: 他们也得以追踪到许多其他幸存者。

sentences.en: Many of the women refused to cooperate with the investigation, preferring to forget their ordeal.
sentences.zh: 许多女性拒绝配合调查，宁愿忘记这段痛苦的经历。

sentences.en: However, several were willing to proceed with pressing charges.
sentences.zh: 然而，有几位愿意继续提出指控。

sentences.en: Despite uncovering a long list of women who had been violated by Joji Ibarra,
sentences.zh: 尽管揭露了一长串被城治·伊原侵犯过的女性名单，

sentences.en: investigators were unable to find anything in his diaries or videotapes to confirm Lucy Blackman was one of his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 调查人员却无法在他的日记或录像带中找到任何证据来证实露西·布莱克曼是他的受害者之一。

sentences.en: But they did find strands of long blonde hairs in the bathroom of Ibarra's Zushi Marina apartment.
sentences.zh: 但他们在伊原逗子玛丽娜公寓的浴室里发现了长长的金发。

sentences.en: They were tested for DNA and came back with a match.
sentences.zh: 经DNA检测，结果匹配成功。

sentences.en: The DNA sequence matched hairs taken from Lucy's Tokyo apartment and samples that had been provided by her family.
sentences.zh: DNA序列与从露西东京公寓提取的头发以及她家人提供的样本相符。

sentences.en: Several rolls of film found on Ibarra's property were later developed and also provided concrete evidence that Lucy had entered his apartment.
sentences.zh: 在伊原房产中发现的几卷胶卷后来被冲洗出来，也提供了露西曾进入他公寓的确凿证据。

sentences.en: There, amongst the images, were two photographs of Lucy, smiling as she posed on the balcony of Izushi Marina apartment.
sentences.zh: 在这些照片中，有两张露西的照片，她微笑着在逗子玛丽娜公寓的阳台上摆姿势。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the phone Lucy had used to call Louise Phillips on the day she went missing was also recovered, providing another direct link between Lucy and the accused.
sentences.zh: 此外，露西在失踪当天用来给路易丝·菲利普斯打电话的手机也被找回，这提供了露西与被告之间的另一个直接联系。

sentences.en: Receipts from multiple stores revealed that on July 4, just three days after Lucy vanished,
sentences.zh: 多家商店的收据显示，在7月4日，也就是露西失踪仅三天后，

sentences.en: Ibarra had purchased several suspicious items that would assist with the disposal of a body, including cement, large camping tubs, gloves, a shovel, an axe, and a chainsaw.
sentences.zh: 伊原购买了几件可疑物品，这些物品有助于处理尸体，包括水泥、大型露营桶、手套、铲子、斧头和电锯。

sentences.en: Police now felt confident that Lucy had been drugged, assaulted, and subsequently murdered by Ibarra.
sentences.zh: 警方现在确信露西被伊原下药、袭击并随后杀害。

sentences.en: But without locating her body, all they could prove was that the two had met.
sentences.zh: 但由于没能找到她的尸体，他们所能证明的仅仅是两人见过面。

sentences.en: In November 2000, one month after his initial arrest, Ibarra's lawyer issued a statement in which he denied any knowledge of Lucy Blackman's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 2000年11月，即他最初被捕一个月后，伊原的律师发表声明，否认对露西·布莱克曼的失踪有任何了解。

sentences.en: He also insisted the assaults captured on video were consensual acts of conquest play, which each of the women had entered into voluntarily in exchange for money.
sentences.zh: 他还坚称视频中拍摄到的袭击是双方自愿的“征服游戏”，每位女性都是为了钱而自愿参与的。

sentences.en: Ibarra said he believed police had set him up, ending the statement with,
sentences.zh: 伊原称他相信警方陷害了他，并在声明最后写道：

sentences.en: In the United Kingdom, Lucy's family were provided with no information other than the fact that an arrest had been made.
sentences.zh: 在英国，露西的家人除了得知有人被捕外，没有得到任何信息。

sentences.en: They had to source information about Ibarra's predatory history and his many survivors from media reports rather than police.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不从媒体报道而非警方那里获取有关伊原掠夺历史和他众多幸存者的信息。

sentences.en: Lucy's father expressed his frustration in an email addressed to the Tokyo Metropolitan Police, reproduced in Richard Lloyd Parry's book, People Who Eat Darkness.
sentences.zh: 露西的父亲在写给东京警视厅的一封电子邮件中表达了他的沮丧，这封邮件被收录在理查德·劳埃德·帕里的书《吃黑暗的人》中。

sentences.en: Tim wrote,
sentences.zh: 蒂姆写道：

sentences.en: I am very upset and traumatised that the police do not give a single consideration to how the family feels as victims,
sentences.zh: 我感到非常难过和痛苦，因为警方根本没有考虑过作为受害者的家属感受如何，

sentences.en: and it is disgraceful and inhumane that you do not provide any news or information to the family to help them cope with this terrible and tragic event.
sentences.zh: 你们不向家属提供任何新闻或信息来帮助他们应对这一可怕而悲惨的事件，这是可耻且不人道的。

sentences.en: Tim blamed the fear of being deported for young hostesses not reporting crimes committed against them
sentences.zh: 蒂姆指责年轻女公关因害怕被驱逐出境而不报告针对她们的犯罪行为，

sentences.en: during their work duties, and questioned why the reports about Joji Ibarra from other hostesses had not been investigated in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 并质疑为什么过去没有调查其他女公关关于城治·伊原的举报。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: This makes the police guilty of the disappearance of Lucy, and when the next girl is abducted and raped or murdered,
sentences.zh: 这使得警方对露西的失踪负有罪责，当下一个女孩被绑架、强奸或谋杀时，

sentences.en: the police and the immigration department will be guilty of that crime too.
sentences.zh: 警方和移民部门也将犯下同样的罪行。

sentences.en: As reports of Ibarra's disturbing crimes spread across the world, there was another family that had a strong reaction to the news.
sentences.zh: 随着伊原令人不安的罪行报道传遍世界，另一个家庭对这一消息产生了强烈的反应。

sentences.en: In 1992, the family of 21-year-old Australian Corita Ridgway were left devastated when she died under mysterious circumstances while working in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 1992年，21岁的澳大利亚人科丽塔·里奇韦在东京工作时离奇死亡，她的家人悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: Corita, a model, waitress, and aspiring actor who had many friends, had moved to Tokyo in December of 91 to join her sister Samantha for a working holiday,
sentences.zh: 科丽塔是一名模特、服务员和有抱负的演员，朋友众多，她于91年12月搬到东京，与姐姐萨曼莎一起度过工作假期，

sentences.en: hoping to save some money for the acting classes she was attending back home in Sydney.
sentences.zh: 希望能为她在悉尼参加的表演课存点钱。

sentences.en: She had also recently gotten engaged to her boyfriend Robert and was eager to put some financial savings towards their life together.
sentences.zh: 她最近还与男友罗伯特订了婚，渴望存点钱为他们的共同生活做准备。

sentences.en: Having spent the last few years travelling to Nepal, Mexico, and the United States,
sentences.zh: 过去几年里，她曾去过尼泊尔、墨西哥和美国旅行，

sentences.en: Corita was a worldly and confident traveller.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔是一位见多识广且自信的旅行者。

sentences.en: In Japan, she intended to find a job teaching English, but when that plan wasn't immediately successful,
sentences.zh: 在日本，她打算找一份教英语的工作，但当这个计划没有立即成功时，

sentences.en: she responded to a job ad in the newspaper for hostessing work at Club Ayakoji in the upmarket Ginza district, known for its exclusive restaurants and designer stores.
sentences.zh: 她回应了报纸上的一则招聘广告，去银座高档区的绫小路俱乐部做女公关，那里以独家餐厅和设计师商店而闻名。

sentences.en: Hostessing at Club Ayakoji involved the same task that Lucy Blackman had undertaken at Club Casablanca,
sentences.zh: 在绫小路俱乐部做女公关的工作内容与露西·布莱克曼在卡萨布兰卡俱乐部所做的一样，

sentences.en: chatting with customers whilst fetching their drinks and lighting their cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 就是陪顾客聊天，同时给他们拿饮料和点烟。

sentences.en: Although Corita didn't enjoy the work, she was making good money, and didn't expect to be doing it for long before she could return home with her savings.
sentences.zh: 虽然科丽塔不喜欢这份工作，但她赚了不少钱，她没打算做太久，存够钱就回国。

sentences.en: On the night of Friday, February 14, 1992,
sentences.zh: 1992年2月14日星期五晚上，

sentences.en: Corita, along with several other Club Ayakoji hostesses, accepted an invitation from a customer to dine externally on a group dohan at a nearby restaurant.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔和其他几位绫小路俱乐部的女公关接受了一位顾客的邀请，去附近的一家餐厅参加集体出勤聚餐。

sentences.en: Corita's sister, Samantha, had spent that weekend out of town.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔的姐姐萨曼莎那个周末不在城里。

sentences.en: When she returned to their sharehouse on Sunday morning, another housemate informed Samantha that her sister wasn't at home.
sentences.zh: 当她周日早上回到合租屋时，另一位室友告诉萨曼莎，她妹妹没在家。

sentences.en: Someone had phoned the house and left a vague voice message saying Corita had gone away for the weekend with friends.
sentences.zh: 有人给家里打过电话，留下了一条模糊的语音留言，说科丽塔和朋友去过周末了。

sentences.en: By Monday morning, Corita still hadn't returned home, and Samantha was becoming increasingly worried.
sentences.zh: 到了周一早上，科丽塔还是没回家，萨曼莎越来越担心。

sentences.en: She then received a phone call from the local hospital, explaining her sister had been admitted with severe food poisoning.
sentences.zh: 她随后接到了当地医院的电话，解释说她妹妹因严重的食物中毒被收治入院。

sentences.en: A Japanese man calling himself Akira Nishida had dropped Corita off that morning, providing hospital staff with Samantha's phone number.
sentences.zh: 一名自称是西田明（Akira Nishida）的日本男子当天早上把科丽塔送了过来，并向医院工作人员提供了萨曼莎的电话号码。

sentences.en: According to Nishida, who left abruptly without providing any identification,
sentences.zh: 据西田所说，他没留下任何身份证明就匆匆离开了，

sentences.en: Corita had developed food poisoning after eating bad shellfish.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔是因为吃了变质的贝类而食物中毒。

sentences.en: Corita was non-responsive and slipping in and out of consciousness.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔毫无反应，意识时有时无。

sentences.en: She was diagnosed with acute liver failure, and by the time her mother Annette, father Nigel, and fiancé Robert reached Japan, she was near unresponsive.
sentences.zh: 她被诊断为急性肝衰竭，当她的母亲安妮特、父亲奈杰尔和未婚夫罗伯特赶到日本时，她已几乎没有反应。

sentences.en: Samantha attempted to communicate with her sister, but all Corita could manage was holding out her hand, wanting it to be held.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎试图与妹妹交流，但科丽塔唯一能做的就是伸出手，想要有人握住它。

sentences.en: The doctors were at a loss to explain how the 21-year-old had become so ill so quickly.
sentences.zh: 医生们无法解释这位21岁的年轻人为何病得如此之快。

sentences.en: They performed an expensive blood-washing liver procedure, but with no success.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了一次昂贵的洗血肝脏手术，但没有成功。

sentences.en: The toxins in Corita's body soon overwhelmed her system, turning her skin yellow.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔体内的毒素很快压垮了她的系统，皮肤变成了黄色。

sentences.en: Corita fell into a coma and was placed on life support, as her devastated family stood by and watched on helplessly.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔陷入昏迷并被送入重症监护，她悲痛欲绝的家人只能站在一旁无助地看着。

sentences.en: As Corita lay unresponsive in hospital, her sister Samantha received several calls from Akira Nishida, who provided the same story about Corita falling ill after eating shellfish.
sentences.zh: 在科丽塔躺在医院毫无反应期间，她的姐姐萨曼莎接到了西田明的几个电话，他讲述了关于科丽塔因吃贝类而生病的同样故事。

sentences.en: He refused to provide his phone number or address, so Samantha reported the phone calls to the police and urged them to investigate the caller.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝提供电话号码或地址，因此萨曼莎向警方报告了这些电话，并敦促他们调查此人。

sentences.en: Two detectives eventually interviewed Samantha, who described her interaction with law enforcement as threatening and hostile, and felt no effort was made to find Akira Nishida.
sentences.zh: 两名侦探最终采访了萨曼莎，她形容自己与警方的互动充满威胁和敌意，并感到他们根本没有努力去寻找西田明。

sentences.en: In the hope that better facilities might improve her chances of survival,
sentences.zh: 为了希望更好的医疗设施能提高她的生存机会，

sentences.en: Corita was transferred to the Tokyo Women's University Hospital in Shinjuku, but pronounced brain dead shortly after her arrival.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔被转院至新宿的东京女子医科大学医院，但抵达后不久就被宣布脑死亡。

sentences.en: On Saturday February 29, just three days before her 22nd birthday,
sentences.zh: 2月29日星期六，就在她22岁生日的前三天，

sentences.en: Corita's family made the difficult decision to switch off her life support, with doctors ruling Hepatitis E as the cause of her death.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔的家人做出了艰难的决定，拔掉了她的生命维持系统，医生判定死因为戊型肝炎。

sentences.en: Corita's body was dressed in a pink kimono and covered in flowers, before being taken to a Buddhist shrine in the hospital's basement,
sentences.zh: 科丽塔的遗体被穿上一件粉红色的和服，并覆盖着鲜花，随后被送往医院地下室的一座佛龛，

sentences.en: where the intensive care staff lit incense sticks in her honour.
sentences.zh: 重症监护室的工作人员在那里为她点燃了香烛以示纪念。

sentences.en: Corita was cremated two days later.
sentences.zh: 两天后，科丽塔被火化。

sentences.en: Traumatised from Corita's unexpected death, the Ridgway family made no request to have an autopsy conducted prior to the cremation.
sentences.zh: 由于科丽塔的意外死亡带来的创伤，里奇韦一家在火化前没有要求进行尸检。

sentences.en: However, a small sample of her liver had been taken whilst the doctors were attempting to save her life, and was still retained on file by the hospital.
sentences.zh: 然而，在医生试图挽救她生命时，曾取过一小块她的肝脏样本，并由医院存档保留。

sentences.en: Shortly after her sister's death,
sentences.zh: 在她妹妹去世后不久，

sentences.en: Samantha Ridgway was once again contacted by the man identifying himself as Akira Nishida.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎·里奇韦再次接到了那个自称西田明的男子的电话。

sentences.en: When he learned that Corita had passed away, he insisted on meeting with her parents to offer his condolences and explain the events of their daughter's final weekend.
sentences.zh: 当他得知科丽塔已经去世时，他坚持要与她的父母见面，以表达哀悼并解释她女儿最后一个周末发生的事情。

sentences.en: Annette and Nigel Ridgway met Nishida in a hotel near the Tokyo airport.
sentences.zh: 安妮特和奈杰尔·里奇韦在东京机场附近的一家酒店见了西田。

sentences.en: He was immaculately dressed, although sweating profusely, as he explained he had brought Corita back to his house after dinner as she had fallen ill from eating oysters.
sentences.zh: 他衣着整洁，但大汗淋漓，他解释说晚餐后他把科丽塔带回了家，因为她吃了牡蛎后生病了。

sentences.en: Her condition soon deteriorated, and he called a doctor to administer an injection for the nausea.
sentences.zh: 她的病情很快恶化，他叫了一名医生来注射止吐药。

sentences.en: When the injection didn't work, he drove her to hospital.
sentences.zh: 当注射无效时，他开车把她送到了医院。

sentences.en: Annette and Nigel noted Nishida seemed desperate to convince them he had tried to care for their daughter.
sentences.zh: 安妮特和奈杰尔注意到西田似乎迫切地想让他们相信他曾试图照顾他们的女儿。

sentences.en: He expressed his intense affection for her, saying he loved Corita and had wanted to spend much more time with her.
sentences.zh: 他表达了对她强烈的爱意，说他爱科丽塔，并希望能和她在一起更多时间。

sentences.en: He presented Annette and Nigel with a diamond ring and gold necklace that he had planned to give to Corita for her birthday, and insisted on paying for her funeral,
sentences.zh: 他送给安妮特和奈杰尔一枚钻戒和一条金项链，那是他原本打算送给科丽塔作为生日礼物的，并坚持要支付她的葬礼费用，

sentences.en: transferring the funds to Samantha's Japanese bank account.
sentences.zh: 将资金转入了萨曼莎的日本银行账户。

sentences.en: After this bizarre meeting,
sentences.zh: 这次离奇的会面之后，

sentences.en: Corita's parents and fiancé Robert flew back to Australia with Corita's ashes.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔的父母和未婚夫罗伯特带着科丽塔的骨灰飞回了澳大利亚。

sentences.en: There was no further investigation into her death.
sentences.zh: 对她的死没有进行进一步的调查。

sentences.en: Then, nine years later, as reports of Joji Ibarra's crimes made their way into the Australian media,
sentences.zh: 九年后，当城治·伊原的罪行报道传到澳大利亚媒体时，

sentences.en: the Ridgways noticed chilling similarities to the circumstances of Corita's death, and when they saw a picture of Joji Ibarra,
sentences.zh: 里奇韦一家注意到了与科丽塔死因极其相似的令人不寒而栗的情况，当他们看到城治·伊原的照片时，

sentences.en: they immediately recognised him as the man who had introduced himself as Akira Nishida.
sentences.zh: 他们立刻认出他就是那个自称西田明的人。

sentences.en: Following this revelation,
sentences.zh: 这一发现之后，

sentences.en: Corita's former fiancé Robert immediately contacted the Australian embassy in Tokyo, who alerted police.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔的前未婚夫罗伯特立即联系了澳大利亚驻东京大使馆，大使馆通知了警方。

sentences.en: As it turned out, the Japanese authorities had already made the connection between Corita Ridgway and Joji Ibarra.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，日本当局已经将科丽塔·里奇韦和城治·伊原联系了起来。

sentences.en: Amongst piles of paperwork seized from Ibarra's Zushi Marina apartment was a receipt for Corita's hospital admission.
sentences.zh: 在从伊原的逗子玛丽娜公寓查获的一堆文件中，有一张科丽塔的住院收据。

sentences.en: Additionally, one of the videotapes from Ibarra's extensive collection featured an unconscious Corita as she was raped by Ibarra, during which he dosed her with a liquid-soaked rag
sentences.zh: 此外，伊原庞大收藏中的一盘录像带显示，科丽塔在昏迷状态下被伊原强奸，期间他用一块浸过液体的抹布捂住她，

sentences.en: to ensure she remained unconscious.
sentences.zh: 以确保她保持昏迷。

sentences.en: He detailed the assault in one of his diary entries, writing beside Corita's name,
sentences.zh: 他在日记中详细记录了这次袭击，在科丽塔的名字旁边写道：

sentences.en: Too Much Chloroform.
sentences.zh: 氯仿过量。

sentences.en: The piece of Corita's liver that had been removed by doctors prior to her death in 1992 was recovered and tested.
sentences.zh: 医生在1992年科丽塔去世前取下的那块肝脏样本被找回并进行了检测。

sentences.en: The sample was found to contain traces of chloroform, a highly volatile organic compound intended to be used for anaesthetic purposes.
sentences.zh: 样本中发现了氯仿的痕迹，这是一种极易挥发的有机化合物，通常用作麻醉剂。

sentences.en: When administered in excessive doses, the drug poisons the liver and can lead to death.
sentences.zh: 当剂量过大时，这种药物会毒害肝脏并可能导致死亡。

sentences.en: Although the presence of chloroform had not been tested or detected by doctors when Corita was still alive, there was now no doubt that her death was due to chloroform poisoning.
sentences.zh: 尽管科丽塔生前医生并未检测到氯仿的存在，但现在毫无疑问，她的死因是氯仿中毒。

sentences.en: The funds that Samantha Ridgway had received to help pay for her sister's funeral were traced and led directly back to Joji Ibarra.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎·里奇韦收到的用于支付她妹妹葬礼费用的资金被追踪到，直接指向城治·伊原。

sentences.en: In January 2001,
Corita's mother, Annette Ridgway, travelled to Tokyo and formally identified Ibarra as Akira Nishida.
sentences.zh: 科丽塔的母亲安妮特·里奇韦前往东京，正式指认伊原就是西田明。

sentences.en: The man she and her husband had met with following Corita's death.
sentences.zh: 也就是她和丈夫在科丽塔去世后见过面的那个人。

sentences.en: Ibarra admitted to posing as Akira Nishida and confessed to being with Corita the night she was hospitalised,
sentences.zh: 伊原承认冒充西田明，并供认在科丽塔住院的那晚与她在一起，

sentences.en: though stuck by his story that he had tried to help her after she became ill, dropping her at the hospital out of genuine concern.
sentences.zh: 尽管他坚持自己的说法，称在科丽塔生病后他试图帮助她，出于真诚的关心才把她送到医院。

sentences.en: With the evidence indisputably linking Ibarra to Corita Ridgway's death, formal charges were laid against him for her murder.
sentences.zh: 由于有无可辩驳的证据将伊巴拉与科里塔·里奇韦的死联系起来，他被正式指控谋杀。

sentences.en: In January 2001, an intensive search for Lucy Blackman's body commenced throughout Ibarra's numerous properties.
sentences.zh: 2001年1月，警方开始对伊巴拉名下的多处房产进行大规模搜查，寻找露西·布莱克曼的遗体。

sentences.en: When the search proved fruitless, police concentrated on the beaches, caves and coastline around Ibarra's Blue Sea apartment building on the Muirah Peninsula,
sentences.zh: 当搜查无果后，警方将重点转向了伊巴拉位于三浦半岛“蓝海”公寓大楼周围的海滩、洞穴和海岸线，

sentences.en: where police had been called to investigate strange noises in the days following Lucy's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 露西失踪后的几天里，警方曾接到报警，称那里有奇怪的响动。

sentences.en: The area had already been searched following Ibarra's initial arrest, but this time the search was much more extensive,
sentences.zh: 在伊巴拉最初被捕后，该区域已经搜查过一次，但这次搜查的范围要大得多，

sentences.en: employing the use of sniffer dogs and ground-penetrating radar.
sentences.zh: 动用了嗅探犬和探地雷达。

sentences.en: Approximately 180 metres from the Blue Sea apartment building was an isolated cliff hidden from view of the nearby houses.
sentences.zh: 距离“蓝海”公寓大楼约180米处，有一个与世隔绝的悬崖，从附近的房屋无法看到。

sentences.en: A portion of the cliff had eroded and collapsed, creating a small cave that could barely be seen to passers-by.
sentences.zh: 悬崖的一部分已经侵蚀坍塌，形成了一个小洞穴，路人几乎无法察觉。

sentences.en: On the morning of February 9, 2001, police discovered the cave and found an old rusted bathtub within, partially buried face-down in the sand.
sentences.zh: 2001年2月9日上午，警方发现了这个洞穴，并在里面发现了一个生锈的旧浴缸，浴缸面朝下半埋在沙子里。

sentences.en: They dug it up and turned it over, finding a plastic bag buried in the sand underneath.
sentences.zh: 他们挖出浴缸并将其翻转过来，发现下面沙子里埋着一个塑料袋。

sentences.en: There was no mistaking what the bag contained.
sentences.zh: 袋子里装的东西毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Human body parts.
sentences.zh: 是人体残骸。

sentences.en: The dismembered body appeared to have been cut with a chainsaw, the skull then encased in cement.
sentences.zh: 被肢解的尸体似乎是用电锯切割的，头骨随后被水泥包裹。

sentences.en: The exhumation took several hours, during which time the media learned of the discovery and quickly gathered at the scene.
sentences.zh: 挖掘工作持续了几个小时，在此期间媒体得知了这一发现，并迅速聚集在现场。

sentences.en: Police constructed a makeshift marquee around the cave entrance, the camera crews hovered above the shoreline in helicopters, and photographers boarded fishermen's boats
sentences.zh: 警方在洞口搭建了一个临时帐篷，摄像组在海岸线上空盘旋，摄影师登上了渔民的船只，

sentences.en: to get the best angles of the scene from the water.
sentences.zh: 以便从水面上获得最佳拍摄角度。

sentences.en: Lucy's family in the UK were not notified by Japanese police that a search was underway or that a body had been found,
sentences.zh: 日本警方并未通知在英国的露西家人搜查正在进行或已经发现遗体，

sentences.en: only learning of the discovery as it was broadcast on television.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在电视广播中才得知这一发现。

sentences.en: A post-mortem examination of the body compared the victim's teeth against Lucy's dental records, revealing a match.
sentences.zh: 尸检将受害者的牙齿与露西的牙科记录进行了比对，结果吻合。

sentences.en: Seven months since she was last seen alive,
sentences.zh: 距离她最后一次活着被看见已经过去了七个月，

sentences.en: Lucy Blackman had finally been found.
sentences.zh: 露西·布莱克曼终于被找到了。

sentences.en: The deterioration of her remains was so extensive that no cause of death could be officially determined.
sentences.zh: 由于遗体腐烂程度太严重，官方无法确定死因。

sentences.en: After Lucy's remains were discovered, her family travelled back to Japan to bring her home.
sentences.zh: 露西的遗体被发现后，她的家人前往日本接她回家。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: On March 19, 2001, almost a year since she first departed for Japan, a funeral was held for Lucy Blackman at St. Nicholas Church in her hometown of ChislehurSt.
sentences.zh: 2001年3月19日，距离她首次前往日本已近一年，露西·布莱克曼的葬礼在她家乡奇斯尔赫斯特的圣尼古拉斯教堂举行。

sentences.en: More than 260 friends and family members attended the service, with a large media presence gathering outside.
sentences.zh: 超过260名亲友参加了仪式，教堂外聚集了大批媒体。

sentences.en: Inside the church, incense burnt alongside a framed photograph of a smiling Lucy, a gift from the Tokyo Metropolitan Police.
sentences.zh: 教堂内，香火缭绕，旁边摆放着一张露西微笑的装裱照片，这是东京警视厅赠送的礼物。

sentences.en: Prime Minister Tony Blair and the Japanese ambassador in London had flowers delivered to the service to express their condolences.
sentences.zh: 英国首相托尼·布莱尔和日本驻伦敦大使送来了花圈，以表达哀悼。

sentences.en: Many mourners were moved to tears during a touching performance of the ballads
sentences.zh: 在动人的民谣演唱中，许多哀悼者流下了眼泪，

sentences.en: Wind Beneath My Wings and I Will Always Love You.
sentences.zh: 曲目是《我翅膀下的风》和《我将永远爱你》。

sentences.en: Reverend Charles Walker told the congregation,
sentences.zh: 查尔斯·沃克牧师对会众说：

sentences.en: Lucy was a glorious girl who could light up a room with her presence, her vitality, sense of life and fun, her laughing face, her warm heart, and concern for others.
sentences.zh: 露西是一个光彩照人的女孩，她的存在、活力、对生活和乐趣的热爱、她那爱笑的脸庞、温暖的心以及对他人的关怀，能点亮整个房间。

sentences.en: He read from a letter sent by a Japanese family who had lost their daughter while she was travelling in Europe.
sentences.zh: 他读了一封日本家庭寄来的信，他们曾在欧洲旅行时失去了女儿。

sentences.en: They had been praying that Lucy would be found alive and well, and stated, We are so ashamed of ourselves as a nation.
sentences.zh: 他们曾祈祷露西能平安获救，并表示：“作为一个国家，我们感到非常羞愧。”

sentences.en: Outside the church,
sentences.zh: 在教堂外，

sentences.en: Lucy's mother,
sentences.zh: 露西的母亲，

sentences.en: Jane Steer, told a journalist,
sentences.zh: 简·斯蒂尔告诉记者：

sentences.en: I am pained by the thought of what happened to Lucy before she was killed.
sentences.zh: “一想到露西在遇害前经历了什么，我就感到痛苦。”

sentences.en: She was a tragic victim of a perverted psychopath, and I cannot get the terrible thought of how she may have suffered out of my mind.
sentences.zh: “她是一个变态杀人狂的悲剧受害者，我无法摆脱她可能遭受了怎样的折磨这一可怕念头。”

sentences.en: As a mother, I hope her death was painless, and that she would have felt no fear.
sentences.zh: “作为一名母亲，我希望她的死没有痛苦，希望她没有感到恐惧。”

sentences.en: On April 6, 2001, whilst in custody for the other allegations against him,
sentences.zh: 2001年4月6日，在因其他指控被拘留期间，

sentences.en: Joji Obara was formally arrested for Lucy Blackman's murder.
sentences.zh: 织原城二因谋杀露西·布莱克曼被正式逮捕。

sentences.en: His trial commenced three months later on July 4, 2001, where the public got their first insight into the accused.
sentences.zh: 他的审判于三个月后的2001年7月4日开始，公众第一次得以窥见被告的真面目。

sentences.en: Obara was born to Korean immigrants in the Japanese city of Osaka in 1952.
sentences.zh: 织原于1952年出生在大阪，父母是韩国移民。

sentences.en: Although his parents were poor when they arrived in Japan, his father gradually built a fortune investing in taxis, car parks, poker machines, and property,
sentences.zh: 虽然父母刚到日本时很贫穷，但他的父亲通过投资出租车、停车场、老虎机和房地产逐渐积累了财富，

sentences.en: ensuring Obara lived a privileged life.
sentences.zh: 确保了织原过着优越的生活。

sentences.en: He attended an exclusive prep school in Tokyo, before moving on to the prestigious Keio University, where his father purchased him the Deninchofu mansion,
sentences.zh: 他曾就读于东京的一所贵族预科学校，随后进入著名的庆应义塾大学，父亲为他买下了田园调布的豪宅，

sentences.en: and hired a maid to take care of him while he completed his studies.
sentences.zh: 并雇了一名女佣照顾他的生活，直到他完成学业。

sentences.en: When Obara was 17 years old, his father died in Hong Kong during an overseas business trip, which many speculated was at the hands of the Yakuza,
sentences.zh: 织原17岁时，父亲在香港的一次海外商务旅行中去世，许多人猜测这是黑帮所为，

sentences.en: with whom he was said to have business dealings.
sentences.zh: 据说他与黑帮有生意往来。

sentences.en: His vast fortune was passed on to his children and widow, and Obara became incredibly wealthy.
sentences.zh: 他庞大的财产传给了妻子和子女，织原变得极其富有。

sentences.en: After receiving his inheritance,
sentences.zh: 继承遗产后，

sentences.en: Obara travelled internationally for several years, before obtaining degrees in politics and law.
sentences.zh: 织原在国际间旅行了几年，随后获得了政治学和法学学位。

sentences.en: He lived lavishly in Tokyo, and also purchased multiple properties all over the country, which increased in value during Japan's bubble economy of the mid-1980s,
sentences.zh: 他在东京过着奢华的生活，并在全国各地购买了多处房产，这些房产在20世纪80年代中期的日本泡沫经济中升值，

sentences.en: leading him to form an investment company and purchase several property development businesses.
sentences.zh: 促使他成立了一家投资公司，并收购了几家房地产开发企业。

sentences.en: He frequently drove his luxury cars to high-end hostess clubs, where he spent large sums of money to secure the company of Western hostesses, who served as a status symbol.
sentences.zh: 他经常开着豪车去高端女公关俱乐部，花费巨资以获得西方女公关的陪伴，这些女公关被他视为身份的象征。

sentences.en: It was during this time that he established his sexually predatory behaviour and began keeping records of the women he assaulted.
